title: Monday morning: an admin adds a picklist value in production
description: While the Friday incident was being handled, an admin added a Needs Reinspection value to the installation status, live in helios-prod, to unblock the planners. It exists in production and in no branch.
nextStep: Production now has a value the repository does not. Lab 3.8 step 6 finds it and brings it back through the pipeline.
